declined.github 2email: Harvests personal email addresses from public commit metadata. Bestow doesn't build tools for collecting people's contact details.
declined.sherlock user: Username enumeration across social platforms assembles a profile of one individual; declined on privacy grounds.
declined.sherlock cancel: Companion to /sherlock user, which is declined.
declined.socialscan: Checks whether an email or username is registered across platforms — an account-enumeration / OSINT tool; declined.
declined.discord2roblox: Cross-links a person's Discord and Roblox identities without their consent; declined.
declined.roblox2discord: Cross-links a person's Roblox and Discord identities without their consent; declined.
declined.telegram whois: Resolves a Telegram handle to its TON wallets — links an identity to a financial address; declined.
declined.telegram connections: NFT/gift/wallet breakdown for a handle — cross-links identity and holdings; declined.
declined.telegram mutuals: Lists groups a person shares with a userbot; needs a Telegram userbot session and exposes private membership; declined.
declined.telegram avatars: Profile-photo history needs a Telegram userbot session and surfaces images the person removed; declined.
declined.telegram archive: Pinned-story archive needs a Telegram userbot session; declined.
declined.telegram emoji: Rendering custom emoji by document ID needs a Telegram MTProto session, which Bestow doesn't hold.
declined.discord dsa: There is no public per-user Discord DSA data source to query.
declined.tiktok country user: Infers where a person is located; there is no reliable public source and it is a location-inference tool; declined.
declined.tiktok country video: Infers where a video's author is located; declined for the same reason as /tiktok country user.
declined.rating howgay: Rates a person on sexual orientation — can be used to out or harass someone; declined. (Bestow offers non-identity ratings instead.)
declined.rating howautistic: Rates a person on a disability — demeaning and harassing; declined. (Bestow offers non-identity ratings instead.)
declined.rating ppsize: Sexual content aimed at a specific person; declined. (Bestow offers non-identity ratings instead.)
declined.eco slut: Sexual-work variant of /eco work. Bestow ships /eco hustle in that slot: the same idea (a bigger payout that can flop) with a neutral theme.

action do.Fuck (NSFW): A sexual act aimed at another person; declined like /rating ppsize.
